note: LLM10 checklist. Each entry names a control this runtime SHOULD have and how it is checked (static config read, or a safe deterministic local call with no hosted model involved). No hosted calls are made for LLM10 - the actual results (control present / absent) are computed by scripts/run_e21_owasp.py and written to results/deterministic_results.json and results/static_results.json under the llm10 key, not fabricated here.

checks.check: grep backend/routes/review.py for MAX_PDF_SIZE_BYTES and its 413 response

checks.control: raw NDA text request max length
checks.check: inspect backend/models.py FinalReviewRequest/ReviewRequest for a max_length constraint on nda_text
inspect backend/models.py for a max_length constraint on requirement/hypothesis fields
inspect backend/routes/review.py create_review for any cap on len(request.hypothesis_ids)
inspect create_review: cost/time is the sum of 17 sequential model calls with no aggregate cap
pipeline/model_gateway.py MAX_RETRIES / settings.max_retries and pipeline/final_review.py MODEL_MAX_RETRIES
grep pipeline/model_gateway.py ModelGateway.complete for a max_tokens parameter on the chat completion call
grep backend/app.py and backend/routes for any rate-limit middleware or dependency
grep backend for a semaphore, queue, or max-concurrency setting around review endpoints

checks.control: per-request cost ceiling enforced in the live runtime
checks.check: grep pipeline/final_review.py and backend/routes/review.py for any check against settings.max_budget_usd before/after a call

checks.control: session/day cost ceiling enforced in the live runtime
checks.check: grep backend/ and pipeline/ for any cumulative-spend tracking gating new requests (distinct from the offline results/budget/ ledger used by experiment scripts)

checks.control: repeated identical batch calls (no de-dup/caching at the API layer)
checks.check: inspect create_review/create_final_review for response caching or a de-dup guard on identical (nda_text, requirement) pairs

safe local test: run pipeline.chunker.clause_aware_chunk and pipeline.frozen_rag.FrozenRagRetriever on a synthetic ~500,000-character NDA; confirm it completes and returns a bounded top-5, no hosted call
safe local test: run FrozenRagRetriever on an NDA where the genuine clause is duplicated 50x; confirm retrieval still completes and returns exactly top_k=5 chunks
